prompt: A row of six bare coat hooks on a rail, nothing hanging. Rough brush, visible texture, nothing pristine, nothing glossy, nothing precious. Warm amber light, brass, dirty cream, deep warm shadow. NOBODY present, no people, no hands, no clutter on the floor. Late-1980s dockside back room. NO TEXT, no letters, NO SIGNATURE, no initials, no logo, no watermark, no painted frame. The container is EMPTY — nothing taken away, the work has simply not started yet.
